notes: Failover fix release: switching to a backup provider is now session-scoped only - your saved primary provider is never overwritten and comes back when the task ends; Stop or a newer retry cancels stale delayed restarts so duplicate overlapping sessions can no longer start. Failure detection now matches only explicit provider error shapes (loose words like 'quota' or 'expired' in your code no longer kill tasks) and a 429 rate limit never silently switches your saved API key. Files modified by a failed attempt now appear in the Changes tab after failover. Native launcher fd sweep is fork-safe and frees everything on failure paths. Same signing key as v1.0.9 - installs directly over it.
